newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India buys Feb 16-20 fuel oil cargo from Glencore.
newsitem.headline: India buys Feb 16-20 fuel oil cargo from Glencore.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) has awarded its tender to buy 30,000 tonnes of 3.5-percent high sulphur fuel oil for delivery February 16-20 to Swiss trader, Glencore, traders said on Monday.
IOC bought the 180 centistoke cargo for delivery to Bombay at a $7 per tonne premia over Mideast quotes on a free-on-board Mideast basis.
The tender closed on January 30 and was valid until January 31.
IOC has yet to award its second tender to buy 30,000 tonnes of similar grade fuel oil for delivery February 24-28 to Bombay. This tender closes February 6 and is valid until February 7.
